name: Transportation Building
statusNote: Identification as the fleet garage unconfirmed

facts.text: UNH Transportation runs an Automotive Garage that services the university fleet, with a Garage & Fleet Manager.
Transportation Services' published addresses are the parking office in the MUB and transit at 20 Sage Way, so neither is this building.

verdict: Probably the university's fleet garage on the west edge; not otherwise documented.
notes: notunh's 'Transportation Building' outline sits just east of Leavitt Lane and the Institute on Disability building on the west edge. A search snippet of a UNH campus map labels a 'Transportation Garage' near the Leavitt Center, so this is most likely the fleet garage. I couldn't open the map PDFs (image-only), so the identification is unconfirmed. No construction date, photos or other details found. Consider merging with the Leavitt Lane buildings, or dropping it, if the judge needs more.
